# cato_secondary_azure_vsocket (Resource)

Manages the secondary Azure vSocket configuration on an existing compatible Azure site. Does not provision Azure infrastructure. Import using the secondary socket ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure an existing Azure site with an unused secondary slot.
# Use distinct, nonreserved addresses within that site's native network range.
# Provision the Azure VM and networking separately.
resource "cato_secondary_azure_vsocket" "example" {
  site = {
    id = "12345"
    # name = "Azure branch" # Use name instead of id if preferred.
  }
  interface_ip = "10.20.1.10"
  floating_ip  = "10.20.1.20"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `floating_ip` (String) Azure HA floating IPv4 address within the parent site native range.
- `interface_ip` (String) Secondary Azure interface IPv4 address within the parent site native range.
- `site` (Attributes) Parent Azure site. Changes require replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Secondary socket ID

### Nested Schema for `site`

Optional:

- `id` (String) Site ID
- `name` (String) Site name
